dominant_strengths: Clear typographic hierarchy with the gradient 'work deeper' accent providing focal contrast against the dark slate canvas.
Consistent iconography and badge system (New/Fast/Pro) shows disciplined component thinking and a coherent dark-mode palette.
Stats row (94%/2.1×/14 min) adds quick credibility without leaving the visual rhythm of the card.
dominant_weaknesses: Onboarding overloads the first screen with stats, four feature rows, toggle, two CTAs, and legal copy — competes with itself.
Narrow centered column floating in vast empty black wastes the canvas and feels like a mobile mock pasted on desktop.
Feature rows are visually monotone — same card, same icon weight, same spacing — reducing scan efficiency and emotional pull.
fix_priorities: Split onboarding into 2-3 progressive steps so first impression carries one promise, not eleven.
Use the desktop canvas: pair the card with a product preview, ambient visual, or split-layout for context.
Differentiate feature rows via varied scale, imagery, or grouping to break the repeating list cadence.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral is decent thanks to the gradient and dark polish, but behavioral suffers from CTA competition and reflective payoff is thin since the value prop blurs into a feature dump.
rationale.intent_fit: It functions as an improved onboarding card with clear CTA and feature transparency, but it reads more like a settings panel than a confidence-building first-run experience.
